summary: AST Live Order Tracking polish verified end-to-end against live GLP backend. Backend: /api/glp/auth/session (tracktest.ap3p@mailinator.com) returns token; /api/glp/orders returns order #260 (completed, total_display='£6.10'); /api/glp/orders/260 returns tracking as an ARRAY with one AST shipment [{provider:'Royal Mail', tracking_number:'AB123456789GB', date_shipped:'2026-10-11', tracking_url:'https://www.royalmail.com/track-your-item/?trackNumber=AB123456789GB'}]. Frontend (Expo web preview, 390x844): login → Orders tab → order-card-260 renders '260 / 11 Oct 2026 / Completed / Track order' footer; tapping routes to /order/260 which renders testID order-detail-screen with a Tracking section containing order-shipment-0 (carrier 'Royal Mail', 'Dispatched 11 Oct 2026', tracking number 'AB123456789GB', 'Dispatched' pill), order-copy-tracking-0 pressable (fires Clipboard.setStringAsync — Playwright click did not throw, no crash observed), and order-track-button-0 'Track on carrier website' present + enabled. RefreshControl present on the ScrollView, no crash. 1 CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: HTML entity '£' is rendered VERBATIM on both the Orders list card and the Order detail summary ('£6.10') and on the line item ('£0.10'). This directly violates the review-request acceptance criterion 'Prices render as £ not £ entities on orders list and detail'. Backend returns the entity in order.total_display / items[].total_display / subtotal_display / shipping_display; frontend mapper (src/api/glp/orders.ts) passes it through verbatim without HTML-decoding. Fix is a one-liner in the mapper (replace £ with £ or use a tiny he-style decoder). React Native issues: (1) props.pointerEvents deprecation warning on every render (expo-router/react-native-web internal); (2) nested <button> hydration warning (carried over from iteration_5 — rail-card contains FavouriteButton). 4/4 pytest backend assertions ran: 3 passed, 1 intentionally failed to document the £ bug.

minor.issue: Upstream WP returns prices as HTML entity '£6.10' in total_display / subtotal_display / shipping_display / items[].total_display. Proxy forwards verbatim. Not a proxy bug per se (we must not alter the GLP connector), but the frontend mapper must decode.

ui_bugs.component: Orders list card + Order detail summary / line item total
ui_bugs.issue: Renders '£6.10' / '£0.10' as literal text instead of '£6.10' / '£0.10'. The order mapper src/api/glp/orders.ts assigns `total: String(o?.total_display ?? ...)` and `line.total: String(l?.total_display ?? ...)` without HTML-entity decoding, while the WP connector returns the £ sign as '£'. Fix: decode HTML entities in mapOrder for Order.total and OrderLine.total (and anywhere else total_display is read). Minimal fix: `s.replace(/£/g,'£').replace(/&/g,'&')` or a 10-line decodeEntities helper. Note: Home/catalogue prices (£52.99 etc) are unaffected because they come from a different endpoint that already uses the £ glyph.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning on every render: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Comes from an internal component (likely TopBar/Pressable usage of pointerEvents prop). Reference: console output across all screens — grep the codebase for `pointerEvents=` and migrate to `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}`.

Nested Pressable renders <button> inside <button>: 'In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>. This will cause a hydration error.' Carried over from iteration_5. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/product/ProductCard.tsx (FavouriteButton nested inside the rail-card Pressable).

action_items: HIGH: In /app/frontend/src/api/glp/orders.ts mapOrder/line mapping, decode HTML entities for `total` and `line.total` (and anywhere `*_display` is read). Smallest safe fix: `s.replace(/£/g,'£').replace(/&/g,'&')`. This resolves the stated acceptance criterion 'Prices render as £ not £ entities on orders list and detail'. After fix, the test test_order_total_is_pound_sign_not_entity should be relaxed to assert the FRONTEND-rendered total contains '£' (backend will still return the entity — that's by design, since we must not alter the GLP connector).
LOW: Replace `pointerEvents=` props with `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}` to clear the react-native-web deprecation warning.
LOW: Hoist FavouriteButton out of the Pressable rail-card to clear the nested-button hydration warning (carryover from iteration_5).

rca_of_issue: Root cause of '£' bug: the WP GLP connector formats prices with wc_price() which emits the currency symbol as the HTML entity '£', then returns it as `total_display`. On home/catalogue screens the price string we display uses the raw numeric field (or a Store API that emits £ directly), so no entity appears. In the orders mapper (src/api/glp/orders.ts, lines 44 and 53) we take `total_display` verbatim via `String(...)` and pass it into <Text>. React Native <Text> does NOT decode HTML entities — it renders them literally. Fix: add a tiny decode in mapOrder/mapLine (minimum: replace '£' with '£'; preferred: handle &, £, £). Reproduction: login as tracktest.ap3p, open /orders — card shows '£6.10'; open /order/260 — summary and line both show '£'. Mitigation: single-file edit, zero backend changes required.
